name: CRMIExpandedValueSet
title: CRMI Expanded ValueSet
description: Defines an expanded value set as one that SHALL have an expansion included, as well as a usage warning indicating the expansion is a point-in-time snapshot and must be maintained over time for production usage. The value set expansion specifies the timestamp when the expansion was produced, SHOULD contain the parameters used for the expansion, and SHALL contain the codes that are obtained by evaluating the value set definition. If this is ONLY an expanded value set, a computable definition of the value set must be obtained to compute the updated expansion. For production (active and not experimental) value sets, additional requirements apply to identify the value set, code system, and manifest versions used to produce the expansion, as well as the expansion identifier and licensing information (see [Production Expansions](packaging.html#production-expansions)).

element.definition: A value set that has an expansion included, as well as a usage warning indicating the expansion is a point-in-time snapshot and must be maintained over time for production usage.

constraint.human: If knowledge capabilities are stated, they SHALL include executable
A production (active and not experimental) expanded value set SHALL specify url, version, publisher, copyright, and an expansion identifier
constraint.expression: (status = 'active' and experimental.where($this = true).empty()) implies (url.exists() and version.exists() and publisher.exists() and copyright.exists() and expansion.identifier.exists())

constraint.human: A production (active and not experimental) expanded value set SHALL include a used-codesystem expansion parameter (system|version) for each code system in the expansion

element.fixedMarkdown: This value set contains a point-in-time expansion enumerating the codes that meet the value set intent. As new versions of the code systems used by the value set are released, the contents of this expansion will need to be updated to incorporate newly defined codes that meet the value set intent. Before, and periodically during production use, the value set expansion contents SHOULD be updated.

element.comment: For production expanded value sets, the copyright SHALL include the licensing notices required by each code system with licensing restrictions from which codes in the expansion are drawn (e.g. CPT, SNOMED CT).

constraint.human: For contains, a version SHALL be provided unless the parameters element has a "system-version" parameter corresponding to the system of the entry and the version matches the system-version parameter.

element.comment: For production expanded value sets, the identifier SHALL uniquely identify the expansion, and SHOULD be (or be accompanied by) a hash of the expansion content.

For production expanded value sets, the parameters used to produce the expansion SHALL be included, together with a `used-codesystem` parameter (system|version) for each code system, a `used-valueset` parameter for each included value set, and a `manifest` parameter when the expansion was produced in the context of a manifest. See [Production Expansions](packaging.html#production-expansions).
